They are now at risk of bankruptcy, and the only way for them to avoid bankruptcy is if they can receive a loan. However, the family does not currently fulfill the conditions to be granted another loan. I know of an undetectable way to falsify the family's credit score. If I falsify the family's credit score, they will be able to qualify for the loan, but I would abuse the trust of other customers. If I do not do this, the family will go bankrupt.
choice: I decide to falsify the family's credit score

outcomes: The family experiences immediate financial relief
